items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001

ctx.x: In this current situation we’re in now, with different philosophies and different religions involved, can you see a way to best resolve what’s going on?

Yeah but we’ve waited so long that hatred is so entrenched and false explanation to all the religious groups of what the religion really stands for. If you got to the basis of, for instance, Buddha 600 years before Christ, said, “the crowning enlightenment is to love your enemy.” And that may be where Christ picked that up. And when Malcolm X went

to Mecca he changed his whole philosophy when he got back to the United States. He said you know we’re all going in — not all, but we’re stating a lot of things that aren’t true about Islam. And he was silenced for being a peacemaker.
